title: Erase Inside: region lock drifts per pointermove (locks to the PREVIOUS cursor sample, not the gesture start) — erases neighboring fills it should never touch
description:
FIXED (task 1427). StageArea.tsx now captures the Erase-Inside anchor ONCE at pointerdown (eraserGestureStartRef) and passes it as planarEraseShape insideAt for every pointermove increment, instead of sweptStage[0] (the previous cursor sample). This stops the region lock drifting across fills mid-drag. Kept task 1428's selectedFaceFilter line intact.

EVIDENCE:
- Build: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> exit 0 (all 8 packages).
- Test: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test -> exit 0, 1308 passed (117 files). New test packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/eraseInsideLock.test.ts (3 tests) replays the exact StageArea per-increment drag loop: (1) gesture-start anchor -> drag started in RED never erases BLUE (blue byte-identical); (2) old per-increment anchor DOES erase blue (regression guard); (3) gesture starting on EMPTY erases nothing.
- Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md updated with the Erase Inside lock note.
